name: Thin Hair
description: Hair that is fine, lightweight, and lacks volume.
characteristics: Tends to be lighter in color
recommended_ingredients: Moisturizing agents such as oils and butters
oil_recommendation: Light oils like jojoba oil or argan oil

morning_routine.action: Apply a leave-in conditioner or serum to damp hair

night_routine.action: Deep condition with a mask once a week
night_routine.purpose: To provide deep hydration and nourishment

weekly_care: Use a volumizing shampoo to help lift hair and give it body
heat_styling_recommendation: Limit heat styling or use heat protectants when necessary
lifestyle_tips: Eat a balanced diet rich in vitamins and minerals
Manage stress levels to avoid hormonal imbalances
foods_for_healthy_hair: Proteins from lean meats, fish, and legumes
Iron-rich foods like spinach and lentils
Omega-3 fatty acids from flaxseeds and walnuts
common_mistakes: Using heavy products that can weigh down thin hair
Ignoring the need for heat protection
do: Apply oil to ends of hair for extra shine and manageability
dont: Use large or round brushes that can cause damage
Over-brush wet hair, as it is more prone to breakage
Overstyle with heat tools without proper protection

seasonal_care.summer: Stay hydrated and use lightweight products to avoid weighing down hair.
seasonal_care.winter: Use hydrating masks and oils to combat dryness due to cold weather.
seasonal_care.monsoon: Protect hair from moisture by blotting excess water and using heat protectants.

expert_tips: Consider a custom scalp treatment for added nourishment if necessary.
Experiment with different styles to find what works best for your thin hair type.
